public_notes.text: The Tribe's own history describes Weenuche homelands along the western Rocky Mountains, across parts of present-day Utah, Colorado, Arizona and New Mexico. It explains that people protected and regularly traveled through these lands, and that border areas were shared with other Ute bands and tribes. This historical account is not a map of present-day reservation boundaries or a legal ruling on jurisdiction.
